attchmntText: Visaka Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Visaka Industries Limited submitted an investor presentation regarding audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue of 1678 crore rupees for FY26, representing a 9% year-on-year increase. Gross margins stood at 47.5% for FY26. The presentation outlined current manufacturing capacities of 8.48 lakh tonnes per annum for cement roofing sheets, 3.56 lakh tonnes per annum for fibre cement boards and panels, and 12,000 tonnes per annum for synthetic yarn. The document also highlighted the company's presence in over 30 countries with a network of more than 7,000 dealers. This filing serves as an informational record for the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited.

attchmntText: Visaka Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Visaka Industries Limited approved audited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. Statutory auditors Price Waterhouse & Co Chartered Accountants LLP issued unmodified audit opinions on the standalone and consolidated results. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 39,877.19. Total income for the same period was 40,042.06. Year-to-date revenue from operations from April 01, 2026, to September 30, 2026, stood at 98,762.19. Total income for the half-year was 99,128.53. The Audit Committee reviewed and recommended the results to the Board.

attchmntText: Visaka Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of schedule of Q2 & H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call to be held on Monday, November 16, 2026.
voiceSummary: Visaka Industries Limited has intimated the schedule for its Q2 and H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call. The event is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 11:30 AM IST. The call will be hosted by Go India Advisors. Company participants include Dr. Vritika, Chief Business Strategist and Advisor to the Chairman, and Mr. Ramakrishna Pendyala, Chief Financial Officer. Investors are requested to pre-register to avoid wait time. Dial-in numbers are provided for domestic and international access. Contact details for Go India Advisors are also included for assistance. This intimation is provided in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.
